title: Cup of Joe to take temporary break after December concerts

blocks.text: OPM band Cup of Joe will take a temporary hiatus following its upcoming concerts in December as the band assures fans that they will return “stronger.” The Baguio-bred band announced the break during its “Sandali Sessions: Ikaapat na Yugto” Halloween event in Quezon City on Friday, Oct. 30. Lead vocalist Gian Bernardino described the group’s upcoming “Cup of Joe: Symphony” shows on Dec. 3 and 4 as their “temporary goodbye concert.” “Hindi naman sobrang goodbye,” Bernardino assured fans, adding that the members would still be around and would return “stronger.” READ: Cup of Joe seeks 2027 Grammys nomination with ‘Sandali’ The […]...
